description: Search active federal contract opportunities by keyword, NAICS code (e.g., "541512"), set-aside type, posting date range, and procurement type. Searches SAM.gov's public Contract Opportunities extract, refreshed daily, without spending an API key — ranking matches by relevance with the opportunity TITLE weighted well above its description, so a genuine title hit outranks a notice whose boilerplate contract-clause text happens to mention the term. Returns titles, solicitation numbers, deadlines, and agencies, plus a `mirror` field reporting how fresh that snapshot is. SAM.gov requires a posting date range — if you omit posted_from/posted_to, we default to the last 30 days. Accepts query / q / keywords as aliases for keyword.

_apiKey.description: Optional — omit it. This search answers keyless from the local snapshot of SAM.gov's public Contract Opportunities extract; a key is needed only to reach postings newer than that snapshot.

keyword.description: Search term for opportunity title or description. query, q, keywords accepted as aliases.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-100, default 10)

naics.description: NAICS code to filter by (e.g., "541512" for computer systems design)

posted_from.description: Start of posting date range in MM/dd/yyyy format. Defaults to 30 days ago if omitted.

posted_to.description: End of posting date range in MM/dd/yyyy format. Defaults to today if omitted.

ptype.description: Procurement type filter: p (presolicitation), o (solicitation), k (combined synopsis/solicitation), a (award notice)

set_aside.description: Small business set-aside type: SBA (Small Business), SDVOSB (Service-Disabled Veteran), HUBZone, 8AN (8(a)), WOSB (Women-Owned), EDWOSB (Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned)

name: sam_search_opportunities

limit.description: Number of results returned in this request

set_aside.description: Small business set-aside type if applicable

ui_link.description: URL to opportunity details on SAM.gov

total_records.description: Total number of matching opportunities in SAM.gov

title: Sam Search Opportunities
